authorization_context: Prior budget remains authorized; owner now requested API-backed real extraction.

cost_accounting.policy: Uncached peak-rate upper bound; unverifiable or failed calls retain full reservation.

evaluation.mechanical: Retain every initial, repaired and failed response; distinguish compilation from semantic correctness.
evaluation.reference: Author audit against these predeclared source boundaries, not independent human gold or model-review approval.
semantic: Operation predicate excludes concrete participants/conditions/order while preserving action/API distinctions.
Actual participant roles must be source-supported; ambiguous username insertion may remain unresolved, not become confirmed absence.
Password hashing-before-insertion and named privilege ordering must remain requirement-owned; operation presence alone is not independent context.
Generation output contract, task-wide behavior and exception condition remain represented; supported unrelated requirements survive repair.
evaluation.unit: One natural task; extraction/review/patch calls are not independent task samples.

limits: No protected/new natural tasks, discovery, code generation outcomes, paper or Pair changes.
Fresh open extraction only, without previous graphs, authored normalized predicates or reference answers in model input.
One draw per task. No extra reviewers, resampling after failure or parameter retuning.
No clean causal comparison to earlier Codex runs; model/runtime and catalog conditions differ.
This is not proof of repeated stability. Unknown and failure are retained.
purpose: Run the revised action-predicate/binding contract through fresh API extraction, one ordinary source review and at most one local semantic patch on two exposed natural tasks.
